overview: A mineral provenance register for Jewel of Africa that tracks emerald and gold lots from mining through to crafting, with an append-only event history and an admin panel.
features: Browse and search registered mineral lots
Register new lots and append events to the register
Sticky header with a site-wide text-size control
Per-status explanations you can fold open
Contact form to enquire about a purchase
Admin panel for roles, permissions, reference data and enquiries
